notes: Eenmanszaak (1 employee), owner/instructor Thorsten Heins. KvK 63723492 registered 01-07-2015 (rijscholen-gids.nl). Official site states only categories A (motor) and B 'Auto handgeschakeld' = manual; no automaat/automatic offered. No English-language content on site and no reviews mention lessons in English, so English instruction is unverified (unknown). Conflicting experience signals: clickdrive lists '11 jaar ervaring' and one review mentions getting a license with Thorsten Heins 'in 2010', predating the 2015 KvK registration -- instructor likely active before the eenmanszaak was formally registered; KvK 2015 used as founding basis. Registered town is Ammerzoden (gemeente Maasdriel, Gelderland), but school is active across the Den Bosch region incl. 's-Hertogenbosch, Vught, Hedel, Kerkdriel. Motorcycle/moped capable in addition to car. Faalangst (test-anxiety) support available (+€80). Google rating 3.7/5 (6 reviews) per clickdrive.
